stations.title: Old server
stations.text: Takes the third piece of the address.

captions: At Ashgrove Press, a customer asks the order page for the proof of order 1873.
The old server reads only the order number, so the customer gets the order instead.
You teach your router patterns, values and the best fit, in three tasks.
Now the request reaches the proof route, with the order number in req.params.
One route for every order, and an answer that never depends on which was written first.
